en: The image shows a vintage postcard with a colorized photograph of a tranquil riverside scene. In the foreground, three people are rowing a small boat on a calm river. To the right, there is a large, multi-story building with a red roof, situated at the river's edge and partially surrounded by trees. The riverbank has a dirt path and a few benches, with some scattered people and carts. The background features a natural landscape with trees and distant hills. The sky has a soft, pastel tone. At the top left, there is printed text.
